outcome: Contraceptive decision-making contributions within a relationship
Communication about birth control with providers
Discussion of contraception with a partner
cohort: A convenience sample of English-speaking male patients aged 13-24 years was surveyed.
finding: Young men who had heard of emergency contraception were significantly more likely to have spoken to a healthcare provider about contraception, to feel they should participate in contraceptive decisions, and to have discussed contraception with a partner.
